idea: One curved edge is cut through twelve materials, faster and faster, until it turns back into the rim of a planet and sets.
leave: The same curve is everywhere, and there is more of it to find.
subject: the arc across the lower half of the frame

device.what: a match cut: every shot puts a different material's curved edge in the same place
device.why: keeping the curve still while the world behind it changes makes the viewer see one shape in many things

change.from: the glowing rim of a planet's atmosphere against black space
change.to: the same curve as the edge of the sun, a bread crust, a blueprint and a leaf, each shot shorter than the last

change.from: the first word, 还有, riding the curve over a pink beaded surface
change.to: shots flashing past in a fraction of a second each, the last word 发现 on flowered red cloth

change.from: the planet's rim again, with nothing written on it
change.to: 还有更多值得发现 written along the rim, then the planet sinking to the bottom edge and leaving the stars
